payload.core_mechanism_summary: Precompute four 2D DP tables for max-path sums from each corner to all cells, then evaluate interior meeting cells using two non-overlapping path combinations.
payload.rationale: The solution builds four separate two-dimensional DP tables (dp1–dp4) to capture optimal paths from each corner to any cell, then iterates over interior cells to combine them. This directly matches the 2D DP state pattern.
